entities.title: TypeScript tests
entities.summary: The node:test suites for the shared rules, the Worker's game actions, the page bridge's engine commands and the whole API.
entities.purpose: Checks the server side without a browser or Cloudflare: build.mjs --test bundles each *.test.ts into dist-test/, and npm test runs them after the typecheck. fake-d1.ts runs the Worker's own SQL on node:sqlite in memory, with worker/schema.sql applied, and the API suite drives a RoomCore directly in place of the Durable Object.
boundaries: What each suite checks is recorded in the verification files of the folders it checks: worker/, shared/ and bridge/.
The GDScript tests are in godot/tests/ and run with npm run test:godot.
